prerequisites: GitHub read access to the private Razorpay repositories is needed only if the durable snapshots are absent.
Private github.com/razorpay Go modules must be present in GOMODCACHE or downloadable with the operator's existing Git credentials; credentials are never copied into this tree.
Public Go modules and pinned code generators may be downloaded from their canonical module proxies during bootstrap.
Pinned BSR module commits in each repository's buf.lock must be available from the operator's existing Buf cache or buf.build during code generation.
